name: Veeva Systems
thesis: Vertical life-sciences SaaS with a regulatory-data moat compounding through three reinforcing motions: (1) gross retention >95% anchors the base, (2) Vault CRM cross-sell captures Salesforce-Veeva-CRM customers migrating ahead of the 2025 contract sunset, (3) product attach rate in top-20 pharma deepens (every additional Vault module per customer is structural ARPU expansion at near-100% retention). The compounder is moat × attach, not new-logo land-grab.
key_driver: Top-20 pharma product attach rate × Vault CRM migration win cadence

tier_1_kpis.name: Gross retention (subscription services revenue retention)
tier_1_kpis.break_condition: <95% (the moat metric — everything else is downstream)

tier_1_kpis.name: Top-20 pharma product attach rate (avg # of Vault products per top-20 customer)
tier_1_kpis.current: TBV — disclosed in absolute counts at investor day; commentary in transcript Q&A
tier_1_kpis.break_condition: QoQ growth in attach decelerates by >50% relative to the trailing 4-Q average, OR reported attach prints below any company-disclosed forward guidance/target by >5%

tier_1_kpis.name: Vault CRM named migrations from legacy Veeva CRM (top-20 pharma cumulative)
tier_1_kpis.break_condition: No net new top-20 wins for 2 consecutive Qs in the 2026-27 migration window

nuance.bear_case: Gross retention holds at 96-97% but product attach plateaus and Vault CRM fails to take more than ~10 of the top-20 by end-2027. Revenue growth decelerates to high-single-digits, multiple compresses, no single break trips — but the compounder thesis is hollowed out.
nuance.adversarial_take: Salesforce Life Sciences Cloud could win residual customers post-Veeva contract sunset, capping the migration TAM at less than the bull case assumes. GenAI disrupting clinical trial software stack adds tail risk to R&D Cloud's structural moat.
nuance.stress_test: Track attach trajectory in absolute terms, not just YoY change — the deceleration break condition is designed to catch this. A QoQ deceleration of >50% relative to trailing 4-Q baseline triggers re-evaluation even if YoY growth is still positive.

thesis_breakers_qualitative: Product attach decelerates >50% from trailing 4-Q baseline
Vault CRM net-new top-20 wins flat for 2 Qs in migration window
Salesforce Life Sciences Cloud gains traction post-termination
